title: A Vector for the Colony
author: Ulyana Whitlock
blurb: Rafael Reyes, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
